title: Derived evaluation for locally finite free internal modules
statement: Let X have noetherian underlying space, Λ be a commutative condensed ring, and P an internal Λ_X-module made finite free by a pro-etale covering. For each integer n, the functor K ↦ Hom(P[0],QK[n]) on all cochain complexes is naturally isomorphic to degree-n cohomology of RΓ of the termwise internal Hom Mod.ihom P applied to K. Here Γ is the specified condensedModuleSections functor. The assertion contains neither colimit preservation nor a filtered diagram.

proof.text: Use the ordinary internal-module evaluation isomorphism: sections after Mod.ihom P are naturally additive Hom(P,-). This is proved directly with the free-module and tensor-Hom adjunctions; no ringed-site/internal-module equivalence is required.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Local finite freeness makes module tensor with P exact. Its right adjoint F=Mod.ihom P therefore preserves K-injective complexes. The existing finite-free internal-Hom colimit theorem and its right adjointness also make F exact.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: The derived additive-coyoneda evaluation theorem identifies Hom(P[0],QK[n]) with Hn of R(Hom(P,-))(QK), naturally on every complex K. Derive the ordinary evaluation isomorphism and use the composition theorem, since F preserves K-injectives, to identify this with Hn(RGamma(RF(QK))).

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Since F is exact, its total right derived functor is the functor induced by applying F termwise. The canonical localization factorization then identifies Q followed by RF with termwise F followed by Q. Whisker the preceding isomorphisms by homology to obtain exactly the displayed functors.

theorem condensed_finite_free_hom_evaluation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod (condensedRingObj Λ X)).obj P))
    (n : ℤ) : Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ shiftFunctor _ n ⋙
          preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P)) ≅
        (Mod.ihom P).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          (condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
            DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n)
